description: Authentication and authorization utilities for the RepairPro FastAPI backend, including role-based access control, JWT validation via Supabase, and dependency functions for FastAPI endpoints.

classes.name: UserContext
classes.description: User identity and role derived from Supabase Auth + profiles table.

methods.name: _require_supabase_env
methods.description: Retrieve Supabase environment variables or raise configuration errors.

methods.name: _get_supabase_user
methods.description: Validate JWT with Supabase Auth API and return user payload.

methods.name: _get_user_role
methods.description: Determine user role from profiles table, defaulting to 'customer' if inaccessible.

methods.name: _parse_bearer_token
methods.description: Extract Bearer token from Authorization header.

methods.name: require_roles
methods.description: Create a dependency that enforces user role restrictions.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to validate JWT and return user context.

methods.name: require_authenticated
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to require any authenticated user.

methods.name: require_admin
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to require admin role.

methods.name: require_technician_or_admin
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to allow technician or admin roles.
